versions.subject: Merge PR #4705 from @slincoln-aiq - New rule: WMIC Disk and Volume Recon
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\WMIC.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'volume'
        - 'path win32_logicaldisk'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\WMIC.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wmic.exe" CommandLine IN ("*volume*", "*path win32_logicaldisk*")

versions.subject: Merge PR #5622 from @swachchhanda000 - fix duplicate and fps
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\WMIC.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    - CommandLine|contains:
          - ' volumename'
          - ' logicaldisk'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
          - 'path'
          - 'win32_logicaldisk'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
          - ' volume'
          - ' list '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\WMIC.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wmic.exe" CommandLine IN ("* volumename*", "* logicaldisk*") OR (CommandLine="*path*" CommandLine="*win32_logicaldisk*") OR (CommandLine="* volume*" CommandLine="* list *")
